name: Risk Taking
overview: Scripture encourages believers to step out in faith and courage, trusting in God's presence and guidance as they face uncertain paths. The call to 'arise' and 'take thy journey' reflects God's invitation to possess the promises He has made, even when the way is not fully clear (Deuteronomy 10:11). Confidence in the Lord rather than one's own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) enables bold action, as seen when Peter walked on water toward Jesus (Matthew 14:29). Wisdom also counsels against excessive hesitation, warning that waiting for perfect conditions can prevent fruitful endeavor (Ecclesiastes 11:4). Thus, biblical risk taking involves obedient trust in God’s direction, courage in His presence, and a willingness to act despite uncertainty.
